ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) dominance approximately 85% versus low-intensity (black) pixels (~15%) concentrated at the margins and central peduncle area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Broad white contiguous zones across both lobes. Dark pixels form a central vertical band at the peduncle and a continuous border along the trailing edge. A distinct irregular dark patch is localized at the distal trailing edge of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch; interior angle estimated at 65-70 degrees; depth is approximately 15% of the total vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge is moderately smooth with low-amplitude irregularities. Right lobe trailing edge is significantly more serrated, featuring a sequence of 4-5 distinct pixel-peaks nearing the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary sweep is convex for both lobes from the notch to the tips; the right lobe exhibits a more pronounced change in curvature nearing the outer margin.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of fine, dark, vertically oriented linear tracks (approx. 4-5) on the medial-inner region of the left lobe, perpendicular to the leading edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A large, distinct low-intensity pigmentation patch on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe, expanding significantly from the standard narrow margin width.
